evidence.summary: Measurement before the move found two defects in CR06's own specification. Its ownership named apps/mobile/src/store/useQueueSync.ts but not apps/mobile/package.json, and a source import with no matching manifest dependency is a missing-manifest-dependency violation, so the slice could not have landed as declared; the reconciler enforces changed-path ownership for the running slice, making this the first instance of this recurring defect class that an existing gate would have caught unaided. And four of the six test dimensions docs/architecture.md requires of CR06 were unaddressed by the suite it inherited: restart replay, persistence, durable transitions, and stable identity across retry.

The relocation is a move, not a rewrite: rename-detected diff statistics show both files changing by one insertion and one deletion each, the import of OfflineSyncPort from @pest-patrol/application rather than a sibling module. packages/domain is untouched by the slice.

Every assertion in packages/sync/durability.test.ts was proved by injection: eight faults, each making at least one named test fail. Dropping skipped items from the returned array and returning a copy rather than the same object each failed four tests; minting a fresh id on retry and not counting attempts each failed three; scheduling backoff from enqueue time failed two; treating a failed item as still ready, dropping last_error, and leaving updated_at unchanged each failed one. The sixth injection caught nothing on the first pass, because the record test asserted the field set and a spread of the previous item keeps the key while losing the reason; the test now asserts the reloaded values.
The architecture boundary checker reports 11 workspace packages and zero exceptions, with packages/sync promoted from planned to required.
The full suite passes 10/10 tasks with the queue relocated: sync 29, application 19, domain 335, web 426, api-client 109, mobile 79.

evidence.summary: Re-measurement before promotion, with a compiled prototype, confirmed the recorded scope instead of correcting it. Every path the slice reaches was already owned: five production files (packages/types/offlineQueue.ts and its barrel, packages/domain/offlineQueue.ts, packages/application/mutationOutcome.ts, apps/mobile/src/store/useOfflineQueue.ts) and six test files. This is the first node in the chain whose scope survived the recurring defect-class check intact.

The four further apps/mobile files an unfixed prototype appears to break are cascades, not scope. SyncStatusIndicator.tsx, app/index.tsx, useQueueSync.ts and JobStatusControls.tsx each fail with unknown[] while useOfflineQueue.ts is still broken, because zustand infers unknown from a store whose own state type does not compile. Typing the store leaves all four compiling untouched. Widening ownership to cover them would have been the mistake the measurement exists to prevent.

Probed before writing the change, because the correlated-union pattern usually needs a cast: constructing OfflineQueueItem<TAction> generically from queuePayload(action) typechecks with no cast, a union of actions distributes correctly through a map call site, and pairing action photo_upload with a ChemicalLogQueuePayload is rejected. Production code therefore contains no cast; the only two casts in the slice are the named escape hatches the deliberate invalid-payload tests use.

The changed-path ownership gate was proved to fire rather than skip. Appending a line to apps/web/next.config.ts and committing it made pnpm rebuild:graph:reconcile -- --offline exit 1 with 'changed path apps/web/next.config.ts is outside running-node ownership'. The probe commit was discarded.

The full suite passes 10/10 tasks with every test count identical to CR06's: domain 335, web 426, api-client 109, mobile 79, sync 29, application 19, ui 9, ui-tokens 8, ui-native 7, types 4. A types-only slice that added no test and removed none is exactly what an unchanged count set shows.

The durable queue's retry path decided by packages/application's mutation outcome semantics rather than by its own maxAttempts budget alone, so a conflict, an ambiguous response and a terminal failure are distinguished where the queue acts on them

A MutationFailure rejection type in packages/application carrying a MutationFailureReason, thrown by the packages/api-client adapters after mapping the provider's error and read by packages/sync, so the queue is handed a reason rather than parsing an error message string and OfflineSyncPort's seven signatures stay as they are

MutationFailureReason and MutationOutcomeKind relocated into packages/types, because packages/types may depend on nothing and OfflineQueueItem cannot otherwise carry an outcome; packages/application imports them rather than declaring them

A nullable outcome field on OfflineQueueItem holding the resolved MutationOutcomeKind, recorded on the item rather than only in QueueProcessSummary, because the mobile store persists result.items and discards the summary, so an outcome kept only in the summary does not survive the restart CR06 made the queue durable across

One retry budget rather than two: packages/sync adopts DEFAULT_MUTATION_OUTCOME_POLICY's five attempts and its own default of three is removed, so the package docs/architecture.md makes the owner of these semantics is the one that sets them

The seven duplicated failure blocks in packages/sync/offlineSync.ts reduced to one outcome-driven path, since each process*QueueItem repeats the same attempts >= maxAttempts branch and the same errorMessage() stringification
Tests that a replay after an ambiguous response reuses the intent's existing identity, and that a terminal outcome stops the queue retrying rather than spending the remaining budget
The frozen public surface in packages/types/publicSurface.test.ts updated for the two relocated unions, since CR02's guard requires exact equality

approvals: Recorded on 2026-09-08 after CR05 and CR06 each put it off: CR04 defined the semantics in packages/application/mutationOutcome.ts, nothing consumes them, and the handoff existed only in prose until this node
Making terminal failures visible to the technician and offering recovery is CR09, not this node. This slice decides outcomes; CR09 presents them

Re-measured on 2026-09-09 after CR07 merged, as the first cut required. mutationOutcome.ts still has zero consumers outside its own barrel re-export, confirming the premise. Ownership was corrected: packages/types and packages/domain were missing, and without them this node and CR09 are mutually unsatisfiable, since CR09 cannot present a conflict that CR19 recorded nowhere durable except by parsing the last_error string this node exists to stop parsing. Eighth instance of the recurring defect class, found before promotion rather than during it

Corrected during implementation on 2026-09-09: the re-scope concluded apps/mobile needed no ownership, having measured that useQueueSync.ts passes an empty options object so an options-shape change cannot reach it. That was true and beside the point, because the item shape changed too and apps/mobile/src/components/JobStatusControls.test.tsx builds queue items directly. Ownership was widened to that one file. Ninth instance of the recurring defect class, and the first this chain introduced rather than inherited

Controller decision on 2026-09-09, failure channel: adapters throw a typed MutationFailure carrying a reason, rather than the port returning a result union or gaining a classifier method. OfflineSyncPort keeps its seven signatures, so the test stubs and the mobile composition root are untouched, and packages/sync still holds no provider knowledge

Controller decision on 2026-09-09, retry budget: five attempts wins and packages/sync stops defaulting to three. docs/architecture.md makes packages/application the owner of these semantics and CR04 chose five deliberately. The higher number does not make a failure slower to surface, because a terminal reason now short-circuits instead of spending the budget

Controller decision on 2026-09-09, outcome shape: a nullable outcome field on OfflineQueueItem holding the resolved MutationOutcomeKind, not a stored raw reason and not a new OfflineQueueStatus value. A stored reason would force CR09 to re-derive the kind on every render and would lose the budget-applied result, which is not recoverable from the reason alone. Extending the status union would move getOfflineQueueSummary, getOfflineQueueJobTriage and their tests, which this node does not own the case for

Verified on 2026-09-09 rather than assumed: tooling/architecture-boundaries.json gives @pest-patrol/types an empty allowlist, so the outcome union cannot be imported into packages/types from packages/application and must be relocated
